_description: Anchored-spoke registry: the source of truth mapping Claude Code launch directories (cwd anchors) to stable spoke keys. The plan-creation skills (new-plan, backlog-research / promote-from-inbox) resolve the session cwd through this registry to stamp the manifest `project:` field — the owning-spoke machine identity. The spoke key is NEVER the bare directory basename; it is the registry-resolved key. The `home` spoke is the fallback IDENTITY for an anchorless cwd (one that matches no registered anchor) — it is NOT a sanctioned launch directory; launch Claude Code from a registered spoke, never the home directory itself. Adopters add a spoke entry per project they launch Claude Code from.

_design_notes.resolution: A spoke key is resolved by matching the session cwd against each entry's `cwd_anchors[]` (longest-anchor-wins). A cwd matching no anchor falls back to the literal `home` identity — the anchorless catch-all, NOT a sanctioned launch anchor (`home` declares no `cwd_anchors`, so the home directory is never registered as a launch surface). Two distinct cwd anchors MUST NOT resolve to the same spoke key — a collision blocks plan creation with a diagnostic naming both anchors and the shared key (collision-safe resolver).
_design_notes.override: Plan creation accepts a `--project <spoke-key>` override for a deliberate cross-project continuation; the value MUST resolve to an existing entry below, else creation blocks listing the valid keys (no silent fallback).
_design_notes.binder_home: Each spoke key keys a project binder at ~/.claude-plans/_projects/<spoke-key>/.

spokes.description: Fallback identity for an anchorless cwd (one matching no registered spoke anchor). This is an IDENTITY catch-all, NOT a sanctioned launch anchor: it declares no `cwd_anchors`, so the home directory is never registered as a launch surface. A session whose cwd matches no anchor still resolves its `project:` stamp here via the resolver's literal-`home` fallback. Launch Claude Code from a registered spoke, not the home directory.
